mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and prompting equity investors to demand higher risk premiums, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 9.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns over 60 days in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 94.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real economic output, increasing the likelihood of corporate earnings deterioration and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below 94.0, as confirmed by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is at or below 0.1% and CPIAUCSL is rising above 2.5% annually, it indicates a liquidity trap with inflationary pressure, prompting investors to shift into equities as a hedge against currency devaluation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a collapse in consumer confidence and income, reducing corporate earnings prospects and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative SPX returns over 60 days in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 100k per month for three consecutive months signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 100.0, as confirmed by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past five months, combined with a drop in residential construction (HOUST), indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate investment and earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to predict negative SPX returns over 60 days in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
